material_units.source_text: Every safety statement in the modules has the same grammar: a set of states or parameters, a test its points must pass, and quantifiers saying whether one point, every point or every time step must pass it.
material_units.per_unit_reason: Independently read the exact paragraph90 in the introduction to Sets, Quantifiers and Logic and its following set-builder/quantifier lesson. It supplies a reading framework: identify the objects, the predicate and the quantified scope in a safety statement. Its word grammar denotes this curricular method rather than a classification theorem about all module statements. It gives no numerical probability, invariance or publication claim; no safety theorem or surrounding definition is approved by this overview.

limits: Exact literal classified individually after contextual reading, not by its HTML tag. No mathematical body or universal safety theorem promotion.
